Good, the test server on port 4555 is stopped (the real site on 42899 was never touched). Here's a summary of what changed and why:

## Root cause
Lumina pivoted from an earlier email-cleanup product ("InboxZap") to an AI meeting assistant, but the SEO layer never caught up:
- `app/layout.tsx` still shipped the old product's `<title>`/description on every page, while the actual content was 100% Lumina — a title/content mismatch that kills CTR.
- The blog's 12 posts are all leftover InboxZap content (`gmail storage full`, `bulk delete emails`, etc.) — getting thousands of impressions but 0–0.1% CTR, because they're totally irrelevant to meeting assistants.
- The blog index tried to `fetch('/api/posts')`, a dead endpoint — so it rendered nothing and linked to nothing, for users or crawlers.
- `sitemap.ts` explicitly excluded blog posts (`TODO`).
- `/faq` was linked in the nav on every page but 404'd — its redirect pointed to a `#faq` anchor that didn't exist.

## Fixes made (all verified with a clean `next build` + manual request testing)
1. **`app/layout.tsx`** — fixed the title/description to match the actual product, added OG/Twitter tags, `metadataBase`, and Organization/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.
2. **`app/blog/posts.ts`** (new) — 6 new posts targeting real Lumina-relevant search intent (meeting notes templates, action items, meeting overload, async standups, AI vs manual notes, cross-platform transcription), replacing reliance on a dead API.
3. **`app/blog/page.tsx`** — now a server component that links to each post directly (previously it rendered nothing).
4. **`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`** (new) — statically generated post pages with proper metadata and `BlogPosting` JSON-LD.
5. **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes all 6 new post URLs.
6. **`next.config.js`** — added a 301 redirect for every old `/blog/post-N` URL → `/blog`. These were retired rather than rewritten in place, since repointing an "inbox zero" ranking at meeting-assistant content would be a bait-and-switch that gets pogo-sticked and hurts rankings further.
7. **`app/page.tsx`** — added a real `#faq` section (with `FAQPage` schema, fixing the dead nav link) and a "From the blog" internal-linking section.

One unrelated item worth flagging: `package.json` pins `next@14.2.5`, which npm reports has a known security vulnerability. Not an SEO fix, so I left it, but worth a separate upgrade pass.
